description: Hold specific contacts on the sequence step they are on, without cancelling them. Use this when a contact's onboarding (or any sequence) must stop temporarily, for example while their account is blocked, and continue later from the same step with resume_sequence_subscribers. Nothing restarts or is skipped. A paused contact gets no further steps from this sequence, keeps its entry event properties and stop-condition snapshots, and cannot be enrolled in the same sequence again while paused; unsubscribes, bounces and cancel_sequence_enrollments still end it. A wait-for-event step does not react while paused; an event that arrived meanwhile is picked up on resume. Applies immediately (no dryRun). An enrollment whose current step a worker is running at that moment comes back with outcome in_progress: call again shortly. This is per contact: pause_sequence_enrollments instead stops new contacts entering the whole sequence. Provide sequenceId and subscriberIds, emails, or both (up to 500 combined).

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

emails.description: Subscriber email addresses to pause. Combined with subscriberIds, up to 500. Unknown emails come back in notFound.emails.

reason.description: Optional note stored on each paused enrollment and returned by list_sequence_enrollments as pauseReason.

sequenceId.description: Sequence ID whose enrollments should be paused.

subscriberIds.description: Subscriber IDs to pause. Combined with emails, up to 500. Unknown IDs come back in notFound.subscriberIds.

name: pause_sequence_subscribers

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `pause_sequence_subscribers` MCP tool.

alreadyPausedCount.description: Enrollments that were already paused and were left as they were.

appUrls.description: Dashboard URLs for relevant Sequenzy resources.

enrollments.description: Every live enrollment of the targeted contacts in this sequence with its outcome: enrollmentId, subscriberId, subscriberEmail, currentNodeId, status after the call, waitUntil (when a waiting enrollment next runs), pausedAt (null unless paused), and outcome.

inProgressCount.description: Enrollments not paused because a worker was running their current step at that moment (outcome in_progress). Call again shortly to pause them.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

notEnrolled.description: Contacts that exist but have no active, waiting, or paused enrollment in this sequence.

notFound.description: subscriberIds and emails that match no contact in this company.

subscriptionUrl.description: Owner-facing subscription, upgrade, and billing-management URL when available.

url.description: Primary dashboard URL for this result.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
